posts.title: Can a blog post be handwritten?
posts.description: Can a blog post be handwritten? Suppose I handwrite a post on my supernote, then export it as a webp, which supports XMP metadata. Pretty sure I should be able to read that with javascript. Then, I could embed the webp on a blog post, and write a script that will toggle between hand- writing and the OCR'd (and edited) text metadata. Worth an experiment, I reckon.
